title: Can't change price field
body:
Is there any way to change "price" filed in price widgets?

I want to do it like this:

```
var countryPrice = "price" //default value
if(any logic){
  countryPrice = "price_gb"
}
-------
search.addWidget(instantsearch.widgets.rangeSlider({
    container: '#price',
    attributeName: countryPrice,
    (...)
}))
```

But it doesn't work. I've got that error:

```
generate-ranges.js:11 Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read property 'min' of undefined
    at i (generate-ranges.js:11)
    at Object._generateRanges (connectPriceRanges.js:118)
    at Object.render (connectPriceRanges.js:183)
    at InstantSearch.js:317
```

What I am missing?
